gloss: all night long; throughout the night

definitions.gloss: all night long; throughout the night; the whole night
definitions.explanation: For the entire duration of the night, from evening to morning. Emphasizes that an action or state continued without interruption through the night.

examples.japanese: {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{起|お}きていた。
examples.english: I was awake all night long.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{泣|な}いていた。
examples.english: The baby was crying throughout the night.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{語|かた}り{明|あ}かした{思|おも}い{出|で}がある。
examples.english: I have memories of talking with friends all through the night.

notes:
Composed of {一晩|ひとばん} (one night) + {中|じゅう} (throughout). The suffix 〜{中|じゅう} indicates the entire duration of a time period and is highly productive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{眠|ねむ}れなかった: couldn't sleep all night
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{起|お}きている: to stay up all night
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{騒|さわ}ぐ: to make noise all night

RELATED TIME + {中|じゅう} EXPRESSIONS:
- {一日中|いちにちじゅう}: all day long
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}: all year round
- {一週間中|いっしゅうかんじゅう}: the entire week
